{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'

print('Number of refunded orders:', len(refunded_orders))

# Confirm these do not affect the age computation
print('\nQA orders have age:', qa_orders['customer_age'].unique())
print('\nRefunded orders have age:', refunded_orders['customer_age'].unique())"}
